battle.name: 邦聯戰爭
battle.theater: 安卡什山區與秘魯北海岸
battle.brief: 一八三六至三九年，秘魯－玻利維亞邦聯與阿根廷邦聯、智利交戰，導火線是阿根廷提高關稅、封鎖玻利維亞經阿里卡港出海的路線。一八三六年十月塔拉與拉西烏埃拉兩役，聖克魯斯的入侵在阿根廷邊境崩潰；一八三九年一月揚蓋之戰，智利光復軍攻破邦聯軍，邦聯解體。火繩槍銃只餘舊式長槍，散在安第斯鄉村。

kit.name: 火繩槍銃
kit.history: 比步槍輕的長槍。西班牙人帶著它上船，也帶著它進了美洲。

countries: 交戰一方是秘魯－玻利維亞邦聯：玻利維亞總統安德烈斯·德·聖克魯斯於一八三六年兼併秘魯後組成的聯邦國家，軍隊稱邦聯軍，由聖克魯斯以元帥身份直接統率，兵源為玻利維亞與秘魯的常備營、徵召民兵與省區防衛隊；海軍是一支數量有限、以巡洋艦與砲艇為主的分艦隊，另加數艘受雇於聯邦的外國私掠船。另一方是智利與秘魯反對派組成的聯合光復軍：智利保守共和國派出遠征軍與主力部隊，秘魯方面則由推翻聖克魯斯的流亡分子與南部各省起義者組成阿古斯丁·加馬拉政府；阿根廷邦聯自一八三七年起參戰，由總統胡安·曼努埃爾·德·羅薩斯主持北方戰線。雙方指揮體系都極度扁平：聖克魯斯一人身兼元帥、總統與外交首腦，智利由總統霍阿金·普列托在聖地亞哥遙控，前線分由海軍上將曼努埃爾·布蘭科·恩卡拉達與陸軍上將曼努埃爾·布爾內斯節制；阿根廷北方戰線交給托庫曼總督亞歷杭德羅·埃雷迪亞與卡塔洛亞省的法庫多·基東加。一八三八年起，秘魯的路易斯·何塞·德·奧爾貝戈索在利馬舉兵，自稱恢復秘魯共和國，與聯邦及光復軍三方同時交火，使這場戰爭出現短暫的四方混戰。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Peru-Bolivian Confederation: the state assembled by Andrés de Santa Cruz, president of Bolivia, after absorbing Peru in 1836. Its army was known as the Confederate Army, commanded directly by Santa Cruz in his capacity of field marshal, and drawn from the standing battalions of Bolivia and Peru together with conscripted militia and provincial defence bands. Its navy was a small squadron of corvettes and gunboats, supplemented by a handful of foreign privateers hired to the Confederate service. The other side was the United Restoration, an alliance of Chile and the Peruvian opposition: the conservative republic of Chile sent an expeditionary force and then a main army, while in Peru the opponents of Santa Cruz formed a government around the exile Agustín Gamarra; the Argentine Confederation entered the war in 1837 under the direction of President Juan Manuel de Rosas, who directed the northern front in person. Command on both sides was extremely flat. Santa Cruz was simultaneously field marshal, head of state and diplomatic chief. Chile's president Joaquín Prieto directed matters from Santiago, while in the field the navy was run by Admiral Manuel Blanco Encalada and the army by General Manuel Bulnes; the Argentine northern theatre was delegated to the governor of Tucumán, Alejandro Heredia, and to Facundo Quiroga of Catamarca. From 1838 a third force entered the reckoning: in Peru, Louis José de Orbegoso rose in Lima claiming to restore the Peruvian Republic, and fought the Confederation, the Chileans and the Peruvians alike, turning the war for a time into a four-way contest.
people: 安德烈斯·德·聖克魯斯是這場戰爭的樞紐。他出身玻利維亞的克里奧爾階層，做過駐軍司令與總統，一八三六年自秘魯北部進兵，推翻薩拉韋里的政府，把秘魯與玻利維亞拼成一個聯邦，自任元帥兼最高行政首長；他的計畫是以安第斯天險把阿根廷與智利隔開，再用聯邦海軍保住阿里卡港的航路。他在一八三六年十月於塔拉、十一月於拉西烏埃拉連遭挫敗，率殘部退回玻利維亞，其後在塔拉布科與英加維兩役得手，卻始終無法把戰線推過阿根廷。最後一八三九年一月的揚蓋之役，他的軍隊在安卡什河被布爾內斯擊潰，他逃往厄瓜多爾，之後流亡智利與歐洲。胡安·曼努埃爾·德·羅薩斯是阿根廷邦聯的決策者，他把關稅戰與邊境戰並用，讓聖克魯斯的聯邦背上經濟與軍事的雙重負擔，同時把北方各省的軍隊編入自己的指揮。法庫多·基東加在阿根廷前線扮演突擊者角色，兩次正面打垮聯邦軍；托庫曼總督亞歷杭德羅·埃雷迪亞則率兵深入塔里哈，奪取聯邦在南玻利維亞的補給基地。智利方面，曼努埃爾·布爾內斯是決定勝負的人：他主持一八三八至三九年的遠征，在安卡什山區把聯邦主力打崩，事後獲封安卡什大元帥，其後更出任智利總統。海軍上將布蘭科·恩卡拉達打的是另一場戰爭：他率二千八百人登陸後遭圍，簽下《保卡帕塔條約》返國，幾乎被以叛國罪論處；羅伯托·辛普森隨後在伊斯萊與卡斯馬兩場海戰中以劣勢兵力保住智利運兵船團，聯邦海軍在卡斯馬被擊潰，私掠船船長讓·布朗謝陣亡。秘魯方面，邦聯參謀長阿古斯丁·加馬拉在利馬被推為臨時總統，組織光復軍，並在揚蓋之役中陣亡；路易斯·何塞·德·奧爾貝戈索於一八三八年在利馬起兵，直接促成了邦聯內部的崩解。
peopleEn: Andrés de Santa Cruz was the pivot of the whole war. He came from the Creole elite of Bolivia, served as a garrison commander and as president, and in 1836 marched in from northern Peru, overthrowing the government of Salaverry and welding Peru and Bolivia into a single confederation of which he made himself field marshal and supreme administrator. His plan was to use the Andean barrier to hold Argentina and Chile apart while his confederate navy kept the route through the port of Arica open. He was checked in October 1836 at El Tala and in November at La Ciudadela, and fell back into Bolivia with what was left of his army; he afterwards won at Tarabuco and Ingaví but never carried the war across into Argentina. In the end his army was broken at the Anchash river in January 1839, and he escaped to Ecuador and later into exile in Chile and Europe. Juan Manuel de Rosas was the decision maker for the Argentine Confederation, using tariffs and the frontier war together so that Santa Cruz's confederation carried the double weight of economic and military pressure, while folding the armies of the northern provinces into his own command. Facundo Quiroga played the attacker on the Argentine front, breaking the confederate army twice in open battle; Alejandro Heredia, governor of Tucumán, carried the war deep into Tarija and took the confederation's supply base in southern Bolivia. In Chile, Manuel Bulnes was the man who decided the outcome: he commanded the campaign of 1838 and 1839, destroyed the confederate main army in the Ancash mountains, and was afterwards made Grand Marshal of Ancash before going on to serve as president of Chile. Admiral Manuel Blanco Encalada fought a different war: he landed with two thousand eight hundred men, was surrounded, and came home on the strength of the Treaty of Paucarpata, nearly being tried for treason; Roberto Simpson then protected the Chilean transports at the naval actions of Islay and Casma with a squadron inferior in numbers, while the confederate fleet was broken at Casma and the privateer captain Jean Blanchet was killed. On the Peruvian side, the confederate chief of staff Agustín Gamarra was proclaimed provisional president at Lima, organised the restoration army and was killed at Yungay; Louis José de Orbegoso, who rose in Lima in 1838, directly hastened the collapse inside the confederation.
kits: 火繩槍銃在這場戰爭裡的位置是遺產，不是序列。前線交火由燧發滑膛步槍承擔：西班牙殖民式樣的長身燧發槍，智利與秘魯的兵工廠都能仿製，配短刺刀；遠程火力是青銅滑膛野戰砲，以四磅、六磅、八磅與十二磅為主，木製砲架，無後座裝置，靠牛或騾牽引，另有少量二磅曲射砲。海軍方面，智利用護衛艦與巡洋艦裝二十四磅與十二磅砲，邦聯方則有 Socabaya、Junín、Fundador 等數艘舊式巡洋艦與砲艇，外加數艘法國私掠船。騎兵在安第斯與潘帕並非主力：秘魯方面的長矛騎槍手與智利、阿根廷側的彎刀騎手用來掩護步兵與砲隊，套索仍在使用。火繩槍銃與這件裝備相關之處在於它的歷史身分：它是西班牙人帶進美洲的舊式長槍，到十八、十九世紀之交早已被燧發槍淘汰，只在安第斯山區的鄉村、邊民與獵戶手中作為獵槍與自衛武器留傳，軍械庫與牧場的槍架上偶爾可見。真正決定作戰節奏的是補給：火藥、硝石與糧食靠阿里卡港與科比哈港海運上山，再由騾隊轉運，路窄坡陡，一次進攻所攜的彈藥與糧食撐不了多久，所以雙方都避免長期圍城。
kitsEn: The arquebus's place in this war was that of a legacy, not of an order of battle. The fighting was carried by flintlock smoothbore muskets: long-barrelled Spanish colonial patterns that the arsenals of both Chile and Peru could copy, fitted with short bayonets. Long-range firepower was smoothbore bronze field artillery of four, six, eight and twelve pounds, on wooden carriages, without recoil apparatus, hauled by oxen or mules, together with a few two-pounder curved pieces. At sea, Chile armed frigates and corvettes with twenty-four and twelve pounders, while the confederation had old corvettes and gunboats such as the Socabaya, the Junín and the Fundador, backed by French privateers. Cavalry was not the decisive arm in the Andes or the Pampas: the Peruvian lancers and the sabre-armed riders of Chile and Argentina were used to cover the infantry and the guns, and the lariat was still in use. The arquebus belongs to this war through its historical identity rather than its employment. It was the old long gun that the Spaniards carried into the Americas, displaced by the flintlock by the turn of the nineteenth century, and it survived only as a hunting piece and a weapon of self-defence among the villages, frontier families and hunters of the Andean highlands, now and then seen in an arsenal rack or on the wall of a ranch. What actually governed the rhythm of operations was supply. Gunpowder, saltpetre and provisions came up from the ports of Arica and Cobija by sea and were then carried by mule train along narrow, steep tracks; the ammunition and food a single advance could carry would not last long, and both sides therefore avoided prolonged sieges.
tactics: 南美洲這場戰爭的戰術幾乎完全由地形與補給決定。阿根廷前線上，聖克魯斯企圖以安第斯正面突破把塔拉法爾西米特的邊境連成一片，但他既沒有打通山道，也沒有足夠的輜重，基東加採取的正是邊防式消耗：不與聯邦主力正面對決，而以地方民兵與騎兵不斷襲擾其側翼與糧道，拖延到聯邦軍在新收復的薩爾塔與胡胡伊一線站不住腳，才在塔拉與拉西烏埃拉兩處開戰，兩役皆勝，逼聯邦軍退回玻利維亞。智利方面一八三七年的教訓恰恰相反：布蘭科·恩卡拉達率二千八百人登陸，遠程行軍的消耗與高山病使部隊大幅減員，被聖克魯斯的軍隊迂迴包圍在阿雷基帕，最後靠一紙條約撤出，說明遠征軍若沒有海上補給線與本國基地配合就寸步難行。一八三八年起布爾內斯改走海路：七月率五千四百人自智利出發，在南部港口分批登陸，八月二十一日在利馬城外的波塔達德·吉亞斯打贏第一仗，十月底占領利馬，十一月三日又因聽聞聖克魯斯主力逼近而主動放棄、轉往瓦喬，顯示進攻方在縱深補給上仍是弱點。最後的揚蓋之役是典型的高地決戰：聖克魯斯占領揚蓋鎮企圖切斷智利軍的糧食與撤退路線，布爾內斯不回頭，反而回身攻擊，占據潘德阿蘇卡爾與普尼揚兩丘，以高處射擊安卡什河岸的聯邦縱隊，再逐次奪回丘頂，最後在河邊把聯邦主力擊潰。海上則是一場護航戰：辛普森以數量較少的智利分艦隊在伊斯萊與卡斯馬攔截邦聯艦隊與私掠船，護住運兵船團，卡斯馬之後智利控制了南太平洋，隨後封鎖卡亞俄，切斷邦聯的外來火藥與槍械。
tacticsEn: The tactics of this South American war were decided almost entirely by terrain and supply. On the Argentine front Santa Cruz tried to break through the Andes and stitch together the frontier of the provinces of the Tucumán, but he had neither opened the mountain roads nor carried enough transport, so Quiroga resorted to frontier-style attrition. He declined to meet the confederate main army head on and instead harried its flanks and supply lines with local militia and riders until the confederate troops could not hold the line in the recently recaptured Salta and Jujuy, and only then fought at El Tala and La Ciudadela, winning both and driving the confederate army back into Bolivia. The lesson of Chile's year of 1837 was the opposite. Blanco Encalada landed with two thousand eight hundred men; the attrition of a forced march and the altitude sickness thinned his force, Santa Cruz's troops turned his position and ringed him at Arequipa, and he withdrew on the strength of a treaty. A landing force without a sea supply line and a base at home, the campaign showed, could not advance at all. From 1838 Bulnes went by sea instead: in July he sailed five thousand four hundred men out of Chile and landed them in divisions at the southern ports, won his first action at Portada de Guías outside Lima on 21 August, occupied Lima at the end of October, and then abandoned it on 3 November on news that Santa Cruz's main army was advancing, which showed that the attacker was still weakest in the depth of his supply. The last battle, at Yungay, was a textbook contest for high ground. Santa Cruz took the town of Yungay in order to cut the food and the retreat of the Chilean army; Bulnes did not continue the withdrawal but turned back, seized the hills of Pan de Azúcar and Punyán, brought the confederate columns in the Anchash river valley under fire from above, took the crests one by one, and finally broke the confederate main force on the river itself. At sea the contest was one of escort: Simpson intercepted the confederate squadron and the privateers at Islay and Casma with a smaller Chilean force, and after Casma Chile held the south Pacific and blockaded Callao, cutting off the confederation's foreign gunpowder and small arms.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。智利陸軍在光復軍序列中，1837年為二千八百九十八人，1838至三九年為八千二百人；其中布爾內斯於1838年7月率五千四百人自智利出發，其後另有八百名智利援兵抵達，智利本土另組織了二千名新兵但戰爭結束前未能啟航。秘魯光復軍在1837年只有四百零二人，1838至三九年約三千人。邦聯軍總數約一萬二千人，但分散配置在全國各地，據點之間靠山道連接。海軍方面，邦聯方1836年有四艘武裝艦與兩艘運輸船，1837年增至五艘武裝艦與五艘砲艇，1838年初為六艘武裝艦，同年末只剩三艘砲艇，另有受雇私掠船1838年末兩艘、1839年四艘；智利方面在伊斯萊海戰出動五艘，即 Aquiles、Arequipeño、Libertad、Valparaíso 與 Monteagudo。揚蓋一役的傷亡數字是全場最可靠的：邦聯軍死傷二千四百餘人（其中多數為陣亡），被俘一千六百餘人；智利軍約一千三百人陣亡、四百人受傷。關鍵日期依序為：1837年11月17日《保卡帕塔條約》、1838年1月12日伊斯萊海戰、1838年8月21日波塔達德·吉亞斯之戰、1838年10月底智利軍占領利馬、11月3日放棄、1839年1月12日卡斯馬海戰、1839年1月的揚蓋之役、1839年4月第二次占領利馬、1839年8月25日加馬拉宣佈解散邦聯與南北秘魯共和國、1839年10月19日智利軍撤出。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Chilean army in the restoration force numbered two thousand eight hundred and ninety-eight men in 1837 and eight thousand two hundred in 1838 and 1839; of these, Bulnes sailed five thousand four hundred out of Chile in July 1838, joined later in the year by eight hundred Chilean reinforcements, while two thousand further recruits were organised in Chile but never sailed before the war ended. The Peruvian restoration army had only four hundred and two men in 1837 and about three thousand in 1838 and 1839. The confederate army numbered about twelve thousand in all, but was scattered across the entire territory, with its positions tied together by mountain tracks. At sea the confederation had four armed ships and two transports in 1836, five armed ships and five gunboats in 1837, six armed ships in early 1838 and only three gunboats by the end of that year, with two hired privateers at the end of 1838 and four in 1839; Chile brought five ships to the action of Islay, the Aquiles, the Arequipeño, the Libertad, the Valparaíso and the Monteagudo. The casualty figures for Yungay are the most reliable in the campaign: the confederate army lost over two thousand four hundred men, mostly killed, and more than one thousand six hundred were taken prisoner; the Chilean army had about one thousand three hundred dead and four hundred wounded. The key dates in order are: 17 November 1837, the Treaty of Paucarpata; 12 January 1838, the naval action of Islay; 21 August 1838, the battle of Portada de Guías; the end of October 1838, the Chilean occupation of Lima, and its abandonment on 3 November; 12 January 1839, the naval action of Casma; the battle of Yungay in January 1839; April 1839, the second occupation of Lima; 25 August 1839, Gamarra's proclamation dissolving the Confederation and the northern and southern Peruvian republics; and 19 October 1839, the Chilean withdrawal.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最直接的一層是關稅與封鎖：一八三五年阿根廷邦聯大幅提高進口稅率，而失去海岸線的玻利維亞只能經秘魯的阿里卡港出口貨物，阿根廷的關稅牆與對阿里卡港方向的封鎖，等於掐住聯邦的財政命脈，於是聯邦與阿根廷從經濟戰走向軍事衝突。第二層是聖克魯斯的政治工程：他在一八三六年自秘魯北部入軍，推翻薩拉韋里的政府，宣布成立秘魯－玻利維亞邦聯，並把秘魯南部幾個省併入版圖；這些省份正是智利覬覦已久的目標，而玻利維亞的波托西銀礦又是智利工業的原料來源，聯邦一出現，智利與秘魯的愛國者都視為威脅。第三層是聯邦內部的反對派：秘魯南部各城的商會、地方議員與部分教士並不願服從聖克魯斯的中央集權，當智利兵一到，這些勢力立刻改旗易幟，讓一八三八年之後的戰局急轉直下。背景上，這幾個新生的共和國財政吃緊、軍隊以徵召民兵為主、沒有兵工與馬匹供應體系，任何一場會戰都難以持久，於是彼此都選擇用短期會戰、封鎖與游擊互相消耗。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The most immediate was tariffs and blockade. In 1835 the Argentine Confederation raised import duties sharply, and Bolivia, having lost its own coastline, could only ship its goods out through the Peruvian port of Arica; the Argentine tariff wall and the closure of the approaches to Arica strangled the confederation's finances, and the confrontation moved from economic war to military war. The second layer was Santa Cruz's political construction. In 1836 he marched in from northern Peru, overthrew the government of Salaverry, proclaimed the Peru-Bolivian Confederation and folded several of the southern Peruvian provinces into it. Those provinces were precisely the territory Chile coveted, and the silver of Potosí in Bolivia was the raw material of Chilean industry, so the moment the Confederation appeared it was read in Chile and Peru as a threat. The third layer lay inside the Confederation. The commercial corporations, local assemblymen and parts of the clergy of the southern Peruvian cities had no wish to submit to Santa Cruz's centralisation, and the moment Chilean troops appeared they changed sides, which is what turned the war around in 1838. Behind all this, these new republics were fiscally strained, their armies were conscripted militias without arsenals or a horse supply system, and no set-piece engagement could be sustained for long, so each side chose short actions, blockades and harassment to bleed the other.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是秘魯－玻利維亞邦聯的解體。一八三九年一月的揚蓋慘敗之後，聖克魯斯出逃，玻利維亞的軍人推翻他，秘魯則在加馬拉主持下於八月合併南北兩邦、恢復單一共和國；但和平並沒有因此來臨，聖克魯斯在玻利維亞又打了兩年，一八四一年十一月十八日英加維之役加馬拉陣亡、玻利維亞反勝並攻入阿里卡，戰爭一直拖到一八四二年才以和約收場，玻利維亞也從此自恃國力，把擴張的方向轉向秘魯。智利方面收穫最大：軍隊在戰爭中膨脹到原來的三倍，稅收與中央官僚機構隨之擴充，保守共和國度過了一段政治上相對穩定的時期；布爾內斯以安卡什大元帥的頭銜回國，其後出任總統，把安第斯山脈與北部太平洋一帶的影響力固定在智利手上，這份地緣收穫一直延續到半個世紀後的南美洲太平洋戰爭。阿根廷邦聯的羅薩斯也沒有得到預期成果：北方戰線的僵持消耗了他的財政與軍力，而聯邦在烏拉圭方向、與法國的關稅衝突、與智利及流亡反對派之間的種種糾葛同時存在，使他無法集中力量；反過來，這場戰爭強化了各省對布宜諾斯艾利斯的怨氣，也把考迪羅式的軍人政治推向主流。文化上，智利與秘魯的國族敘事在這幾年裡成形：以光復為名的戰爭把祖國與秩序兩個詞變成日後十九世紀拉丁美洲政治的基本詞彙。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the war was the dissolution of the Peru-Bolivian Confederation. After the defeat at Yungay in January 1839 Santa Cruz fled, Bolivia's officers deposed him, and Peru under Gamarra merged the northern and southern states in August and restored a single republic. Peace did not follow, however. Santa Cruz fought on for two more years in Bolivia; at Ingaví on 18 November 1841 Gamarra was killed, Bolivia won the action and carried the war into Arica, and only a treaty in 1842 closed the affair. Bolivia, confident in its own strength, then turned its expansion against Peru. Chile gained the most. Its army tripled during the war, taxation and the central bureaucracy expanded with it, and the conservative republic passed through a period of relative political stability; Bulnes returned with the title of Grand Marshal of Ancash and afterwards became president, fixing Chilean influence over the Andean chain and the northern Pacific, a territorial gain that endured until the South American wars of the Pacific half a century later. Rosas of the Argentine Confederation did not get what he expected. The paralysis of the northern front consumed his finances and his troops while the Confederation faced pressures at once from Uruguay, from the customs conflict with France, and from the Chilean connection and the exiles, and he could never concentrate his strength. In the other direction, the war sharpened the provinces' resentment of Buenos Aires and pushed caudillo-style military politics into the mainstream. On the cultural side, the national narratives of Chile and Peru took shape in these years: a war fought under the name of restoration turned patria and order into the basic vocabulary of nineteenth-century Latin American politics.
result: 結果是聯邦軍的崩潰與兩個共和國的復國。一八三九年一月的揚蓋之役，聖克魯斯的軍隊在潘德阿蘇卡爾與普尼揚兩丘之下被壓制，死傷二千四百餘人、被俘一千六百餘人，參謀長加馬拉陣亡；聖克魯斯本人在揚蓋一帶失散，之後退往厄瓜多爾。智利與秘魯光復軍趁勢南下，四月第二次占領利馬，隨後依條約撤出，智利軍於十月十九日離開秘魯，戰事至此結束。八月二十五日，加馬拉以秘魯總統身分正式宣佈解散秘魯－玻利維亞邦聯與南北秘魯共和國，兩地重新合併為一個秘魯共和國；玻利維亞則在聖克魯斯被推翻後另立政府，阿根廷邦聯與玻利維亞之間於一八四二年以條約劃界，把胡胡伊以北被佔據的土地歸還。戰爭的最後一段不屬於這場，而是它的後續：玻利維亞在一八四一年英加維戰勝秘魯，一八四二年和約又把秘魯北部的土地還回，此後玻利維亞又把矛頭指向南方，十九世紀後半葉安第斯山區的邊界糾紛由此開始累積。
resultEn: The result was the collapse of the confederate army and the restoration of two republics. At Yungay in January 1839 Santa Cruz's troops were broken beneath the hills of Pan de Azúcar and Punyán, losing over two thousand four hundred men and more than one thousand six hundred prisoners, and the chief of staff Gamarra was killed; Santa Cruz himself was separated from his army around Yungay and afterwards withdrew towards Ecuador. The Chilean and Peruvian restoration armies pressed south, occupied Lima a second time in April, and then withdrew under the terms of the agreement, the Chilean force leaving Peru on 19 October, and with that the fighting ended. On 25 August Gamarra, as president of Peru, formally proclaimed the dissolution of the Peru-Bolivian Confederation and of the northern and southern Peruvian republics, the two being merged once more into a single Peruvian Republic; Bolivia, having thrown Santa Cruz out, set up a government of its own, and in 1842 a treaty between the Argentine Confederation and Bolivia fixed a frontier and returned the occupied lands north of Jujuy. The last phase of the fighting was not part of this war but its sequel: Bolivia won at Ingaví in 1841, the peace of 1842 gave back the northern Peruvian territories, and from then on Bolivia turned south again, so that the frontier disputes of the Andean region began to accumulate through the second half of the nineteenth century.
